objective: Gate 8E R3-R4 quirurgico. El RESULT R3-R3 solo publico check_failed:sql_readonly_audit y no conservo la excepcion SQL interna. Para eliminar la familia de fallo sin adivinar, auditar la existencia de config/provider/template reutilizable para Catalogo Ampliado usando exclusivamente columnas fisicas de dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig y busqueda textual sanitizada con LIKE; prohibido JSON_VALUE, ISJSON, OPENJSON o parseo JSON. No devolver PayloadMongo, secretos, destinatarios ni texto de templates. Sin DML/DDL, sin envios, sin Produccion.

queries.name: readonly_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: notification_config_collection_counts
queries.sql: SELECT ColeccionOrigen,Activo,COUNT_BIG(*) AS cantidad FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig GROUP BY ColeccionOrigen,Activo ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen,Activo

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_candidate_flags
queries.sql: SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,LEN(PayloadMongo) AS payload_length,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo ampliado%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS menciona_catalogo_ampliado,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%vencim%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS menciona_vencimiento,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%email%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS menciona_email,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%whatsapp%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS menciona_whatsapp,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%template%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS menciona_template,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%provider%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%twilio%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%smtp%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS menciona_provider FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo ampliado%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%vencim%') ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen,Id

constraints: Use only physical columns and sanitized boolean flags
